name: Progress photo note field
gap: A note is stored on the photo record and shown in the lightbox, but there is no field anywhere to type or edit one — every photo added in this build has note:''.

name: Analysis result panels (summary / composition / observations / strengths / focus / qualifier)
gap: No result panels at all — no summary, composition, observations, strengths, focus or qualifier, because nothing ever returns.

name: Weak point → prescription cards
gap: No weak-point prescription cards.

name: "ADD TO SPLIT" from a weak point
gap: No ADD TO SPLIT from an analysis.

name: "Tap a photo → Analyse Physique" hint banner
gap: No hint banner pointing at the analyse path; the entry is only the button inside an opened photo.

name: Workout detail (edit / delete / convert to split) from Home
gap: Rows hand workout-detail the id (lk_openWorkout) and edit, delete and Repeat all work; "Convert to split" is cut — workout-detail.html:40: "REPEAT, NOT CONVERT. The original offered 'Convert to split', which makes a whole training split out of one day. That is a bigger claim than one session supports".

name: Goals list (active + completed)
gap: One flat list in a sheet: no active/completed split, no COMPLETED section, no per-goal tap target and no empty state.

name: Create / edit a goal
gap: Create works and persists to lk_goals with type, start, target, unit and date; there is no edit and no delete.

name: Goal detail view (ring, start/current/target, deadline, notes)
gap: No goal detail view at all: no ring, no start/current/target tiles, no deadline chip, no notes and no Mark Complete — only a name, a percentage and a bar in the list.

name: AI goal progress analysis
gap: No analyse control anywhere on the goals surface.

name: AI body fat estimate
gap: No body-fat estimate control; the only consent-gated model path on the screen is the photo analyse flow.

name: Beta activity telemetry from Goals
gap: There is no beta telemetry layer in the build, so no goal or body-fat event is logged.

name: Workout lifecycle in the root
gap: The lifecycle works end to end (start from Home or Train, log, Finish, Review, Save, lk_history) but it is owned by workout-log.html, review.html and session.js rather than a root; there is no post-save sync and no activity log.

name: Weight log & refeed trigger
gap: The weight log upserts one entry per day with per-entry deltas and a weekly rate, and the refeed fires only on a cut after three consecutive all-time lows, capped at estimated maintenance. The dismissal is held in page memory rather than lk_refeedDismissed, so v6’s five-day suppression does not survive a reload.

name: Workout identity helpers (`withWorkoutIds`, `sameWorkout`)
gap: No withWorkoutIds/sameWorkout equivalent. History ids come from whoever wrote the row (review.html:1081, train.html:1012); a seeded row with no id would never be stamped, and there is no same-workout comparison anywhere.

name: Mark a set done (✓) — with haptics, pop animation, PR check and rest start
gap: The PR check, the rest start and the guard against ticking an empty row all work, but there is no haptic feedback (navigator.vibrate appears nowhere in the build) and no pop animation on the tick.

name: Cycle set type: Normal → Warm-up → Drop
gap: The cycle is work -> warm-up -> drop -> to-failure (four states, not three) and a drop set is NOT auto-filled at 75% of the preceding set's weight, so the one thing the drop state was for is left to be typed by hand.

name: Per-row unit override (kg ⇄ lb for one exercise)
gap: There is no per-row unit. Both unit controls (the tools menu and the exercise sheet) call setUnit(), which flips the whole app through LKUnits; the column head is the global unit on every card.

name: PR detection during a session + ALL-TIME PR banner
gap: Detection and the write to lk_prs are correct, but the announcement is a four-second toast only: there is no ALL-TIME PR banner on the card or in the header, so a record set early in a session leaves no mark on the screen.

name: Custom rest duration (m + s)
gap: Custom rest is one seconds field (5-900), not the minutes + seconds pair v6 offered, and it is not pre-seeded from the current target; "90" has to be typed as 90 seconds.

name: Hold-to-open exercise action sheet
gap: The action sheet opens on a plain TAP of the exercise name. There is no press-and-hold: no hold timer, no squeeze animation, no haptic, and no guard against opening it from a control inside the card.

name: Post-workout Throwback card (1-in-5)
gap: No throwback on Review, and no comment on the screen saying it was dropped. The 1-in-5 roll, the card and the dismissal are all absent.

name: Add Featured Lift search screen
gap: A lift picker and a searchable records list both exist and both re-plot the chart, but there is no featured-lifts set to add to or remove from: lk_featuredLifts is only read once, for the default chart lift, and nothing ever writes it.

name: PR detail — three summary cards (1RM / Working / Estimated)
gap: The three figures are there, but as three columns on the vault row rather than a PR detail screen: there is no per-lift detail with its own 1RM / working / estimated cards, and no per-record list behind a row.

name: Est-1RM progression chart with 30D / 90D / ALL range filter
gap: The chart is here and better (real date positions, labelled axis), but two ranges not three. Source comment: "The third range option: on this history 90D and ALL are the same data. A control that does nothing is worse than one fewer control." 30D/90D/ALL are 4 weeks / 12 weeks.
